status.summary: Two straight wins. At UFC 328 (May 9, 2026) he was dropped in R2 and then choked out Mateusz Rebecki at 4:42 of R3. At UFC 333 (Oct 24, 2026, Abu Dhabi) he beat the previously unbeaten Nurullo Aliev 29-27 x3: he lost R1 and was hurt early, then took over with takedowns, and Aliev lost a point for strikes to the back of the head. Ranked about No. 11 at lightweight. No bout booked.

style.summary: A switch-stance wrestler who chains takedowns, rides top position and hunts the back for the rear-naked choke, usually getting stronger as the fight goes on. The danger for him is the first few minutes on the feet: he has been knocked out twice in round 1, was dropped by Rebecki and was hurt by Aliev. Strikers who land early can beat him before the wrestling takes over.

moves.notes: Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 81% head, 14% body, 5% legs (landed 73/18/8). The lightweight league is 76/15/9, so leg kicks are near the floor. Ground strikes are 35% of his landed strikes decayed (league 10%) and are not covered by these standing weights. Standing, his strikes mostly lead into takedowns, so the straight punches lead and power shots stay modest (1 knockdown in 16 UFC fights). The head kick is small but not zero because an early head kick stunned Rebecki at UFC 328 (Cageside, BVM Sports). He is listed as switch stance by ufcstats; the split between stances is not recorded. Technique is not in ufcstats, so these weights within each target are judgments.
